title: Closeout summary: T3 FTS5 search in index.sqlite
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented FTS5 search in .boreal/cache/index.sqlite with BM25 field weighting, final-token prefix matching, snippets, feature detection, and JSON fallback. Search field extraction is shared between JSON and FTS indexes; object-index rebuilds and incremental writes populate search_fts transactionally. Dogfood sync refresh reports mode=fts with 1311 docs, search-index.json remains absent, and built CLI search for 'workflow ref' completed in 0.90s with snippets.

Close reason: T3 acceptance satisfied except scoped git checkpoint was blocked by sandbox Git index permissions; FTS5 mode, prefix search, snippets, JSON fallback tests, dogfood search, sync, doctor, and full suite passed.
